skills.trigger: When evaluating a patient with a history of intrathoracic tumor to determine the location and size of recurrence relative to the initial presentation.
steps: Identify the anatomical level of the current mass on axial CT slices (e.g., presence of heart/ventricles indicates lower lung field; presence of great vessels/arch indicates upper field).
Compare the identified location and dimensions of the current soft tissue mass against the documented characteristics of the primary tumor.
Distinguish recurrence patterns by confirming if the new mass is in the same lobe/field as the original or has shifted (e.g., upper to lower), and assessing if it represents interval growth.
